tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The infinite board ground. Warm paper, never pure white.

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dot grid on the canvas; one dot per space-6.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chrome pills, menus — anything that sits on the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: image placeholders, preview mosaic gutters, input fields.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, breadcrumb ancestors, meta. 4.5:1+ on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Text-strength outline used only for focus and dark-ink details; depth now comes from side faces, not outlines.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Primary action and the brand — a warm coral. Ink text only.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Selection, focus ring and 'Open board'. Ink text (periwinkle is too light for white).

tokens.name: lemon
tokens.usage: Notes and highlights. Ink text.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Success, 'synced', close-zoom badge. Ink text.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Child-board tint and playful secondary. Ink text.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text on cobalt.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only; small and rare. Pair with an icon and words.

tokens.name: depth-0
tokens.usage: Root board ground (= canvas).

tokens.name: depth-1
tokens.usage: Ground of a level-1 board: each step inward warms the room.

tokens.name: depth-2
tokens.usage: Ground of a level-2 board.

tokens.name: depth-3
tokens.usage: Ground of a level-3 board and deeper.

tokens.name: tomato-side
tokens.usage: Side face / extrusion of tomato objects (the visible 'thickness'). A lighter, translucent-feeling tint of the face — like frosted acrylic, not a dark extrusion.

tokens.name: cobalt-side
tokens.usage: Side face of cobalt objects. A lighter, translucent-feeling tint of the face — like frosted acrylic, not a dark extrusion.

tokens.name: lemon-side
tokens.usage: Side face of lemon objects and notes. A lighter, translucent-feeling tint of the face — like frosted acrylic, not a dark extrusion.

tokens.name: mint-side
tokens.usage: Side face of mint objects. A lighter, translucent-feeling tint of the face — like frosted acrylic, not a dark extrusion.

tokens.name: lilac-side
tokens.usage: Side face of lilac objects and board stacks. A lighter, translucent-feeling tint of the face — like frosted acrylic, not a dark extrusion.

tokens.name: surface-side
tokens.usage: Side face of surface cards — the slab's thickness. A lighter, translucent-feeling tint of the face — like frosted acrylic, not a dark extrusion.

tokens.name: cast
tokens.usage: Base of the soft floor shadow; objects also cast a glow in their own colour (see README).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; mosaic gutters.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and control groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding at medium zoom.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; chrome inset from the viewport edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Canvas dot pitch; gap between board cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in chrome panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum breathing room between clusters on a board.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, mosaic tiles, zoom readout.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, image cards, notes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Board cards and chrome pills.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Empty/error state panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, badges, the breadcrumb bar.

tokens.name: lift-1
tokens.usage: Chips, small controls: thin pedestal + soft floor shadow.

tokens.name: lift-2
tokens.usage: Cards and buttons at rest: an 8px pedestal side and a wide soft shadow.

tokens.name: lift-3
tokens.usage: Hovered/dragged: taller pedestal, shadow spreads as it leaves the floor.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Pressed: sinks onto the floor.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Outline on every raised object, in edge colour.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, cobalt, offset 3px.
